rules: Reject every unsupported module, operation, field, unit, continuation, override, sweep and conversion explicitly.
Only registered adapter mapping is permitted; original authored definition and derived solver input have separate hashes.
No semantic validation invokes a numerical force evaluation; execute the standalone solver only inside the numerical worker.
Initial and prepared state times are zero; successful output carries primary final time in data and envelope.
Failed, cancelled or unconverged solver reports never publish an accepted phase output.
Conservation maxima include every accepted full step independently of artifact sampling.
Immutable input/plan/phase/transport identities include exact declared units and explicit time.
Use the most restrictive captured generic/standalone/worker budgets; whole-run artifact cap includes all generic and standalone evidence.
Replay requires exact captured contracts, code, dependency and environment identities; captured source is never executed.
